purpose: Freeze the nuisance-only GLMM bridge and robustness-grid expansion before real procedural-pilot data are available, so final power scenarios cannot be selected after viewing pilot nuisance values.

pilot_nuisance_glmm.input: pooled full-information B=3 Pilot B trial log only
pilot_nuisance_glmm.model: correct_within_window ~ 1 + (1|individual_id) + (1|colony_id) when multiple colonies are present; omit the colony random effect only when exactly one colony is present
pilot_nuisance_glmm.timeout_semantics: timeouts remain primary failures because correct_within_window is false for timeouts
outputs: individual random-intercept SD on logit scale
colony random-intercept SD on logit scale
pilot_nuisance_glmm.role: nuisance calibration only; no focal treatment contrast may enter the fit

robustness_policy.crossing: all 3 baseline profiles x all 4 nuisance profiles = 12 robustness_id values at every candidate N
robustness_policy.pilot_anchored_failure_rule: do not clip invalid probabilities. If the pilot-anchored profile makes any 12-cell target probability invalid or above 1-timeout, fail closed and revise the preregistered planning design before confirmatory allocation rather than silently truncating values.
robustness_policy.attrition_failure_rule: do not cap dropout or timeout stress values. If adding 0.05 produces an invalid probability, fail closed and redesign rather than silently clipping.
robustness_policy.random_effect_floor_role: the variance-stress floors protect against a small or singular nuisance pilot fit being treated as proof of zero heterogeneity.

colony_allocation_policy.input: planned colony_count frozen before final power simulation
colony_allocation_policy.allocation: for each candidate individuals-per-cell N, distribute complete 12-cell blocks as evenly as possible across colonies; deterministic remainder goes to the lowest indexed colonies
colony_allocation_policy.actual_roster_constraint: final confirmatory randomization may proceed only if the actual colony supply can realize the selected-N block allocation; otherwise rerun the already frozen power policy with the revised pre-allocation colony count before treatment assignment

claim_ceiling: This gate freezes how real nuisance pilot values will be converted into final robustness scenarios. It does not provide nuisance estimates, power, or a biological sample size before the real pilot.
